title.zh: Rust Is Tier-1 Language at Microsoft
title.en: Rust Is Tier-1 Language at Microsoft

current_state.zh: Microsoft has elevated Rust to a Tier-1 language, notably adopting MSVC's backend in place of LLVM, signaling deeper first-party support for Rust in Windows and its developer tooling.
current_state.en: Microsoft has elevated Rust to a Tier-1 language, notably adopting MSVC's backend in place of LLVM, signaling deeper first-party support for Rust in Windows and its developer tooling.
